signals.label: Comment pod
signals.detail: 41 shared accounts comment across 6 unrelated creators within 13 days; 112 comments match known Thai pod phrases (pattern heuristic, human-review recommended)

signals.label: View spike
signals.detail: Recent posts run 6.2x the account's own trailing baseline

factors.label: Topic fit
factors.rationale: On-topic beauty content and a big follower count — which is exactly why she looks tempting.

factors.label: Engagement authenticity
factors.rationale: ER 9.1% is not what it looks like — comment pod: 41 shared accounts comment across 6 unrelated creators within 13 days. Real engagement is lower.

factors.label: Recency & cadence
factors.rationale: Last post 2 day(s) ago.

factors.label: Audience (advisory)
factors.rationale: Broad; a share of engagement is non-organic — treat audience size with caution. (inferred, not measured — do not quote to client as fact.)

kols.whyEn: Looks like a top pick — 486K followers, 9.1% engagement. She isn't. A 41-account comment pod and a 6.2× view spike over her own baseline mark the engagement as bought. This is the KOL a follower-count tool recommends and a client's budget bleeds into. Flagged for human review, not auto-killed.
kols.whyTh: ดูเหมือนตัวเลือกท็อป ฟอลโล 486K เอนเกจ 9.1% แต่ไม่ใช่ พบพอดคอมเมนต์ 41 บัญชี และยอดวิวพุ่ง 6.2 เท่าจากฐานตัวเอง = เอนเกจซื้อ นี่คือคนที่เครื่องมือวัดยอดฟอลจะแนะนำ และงบลูกค้าจะรั่ว ส่งให้คนรีวิว ไม่ตัดออกอัตโนมัติ
